verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page describes a free migration app that automates moving both code and users from self-hosted Bitbucket Server/Data Center to Bitbucket Cloud. It also offers a matching-size Cloud Premium trial to ease the transition. That covers the self-hosted-to-cloud half of the story, but the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: evidence of import tooling from other platforms (e.g. GitHub/GitLab), in-depth migration documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the migration app works as claimed.
